name: Shakugan no Shana
source:
The player takes on the character of Yuji Sakai in the game. The game plays out like a visual novel but with the addition of a battle system and dating sim elements. Choices that are made throughout the course of the game determine which of the five endings the player gets upon completion of the game.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.or/wiki/Shakugan_no_Shana#Video_games]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
玩家在游戏中扮演坂井悠二。整体玩法类似视觉小说，但另外加入了战斗系统和恋爱模拟元素。流程中做出的选择将决定玩家完成游戏时进入五种结局中的哪一种。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.or/wiki/Shakugan_no_Shana#Video_games]Wikipedia[/url]]
